## QR Label

A printable label for any Record Identifier: QR + the id in monospace + up to two lines of context. Identical on screen and on paper. The code itself is the catalog QR Code field; this component owns only the label layout and the three physical sizes (25×15mm / 50×25mm / 100×50mm).

Generic: any card with a Record Identifier can mount it. Asset's isolated header mounts it at `@size='sm'`; `@payload` is the asset's own card id so a phone camera opens the record directly.
